content:
Tomorrow is Apple's annual most important product launch event, and it's widely expected that new Apple Watch models will be unveiled. Surprisingly, Apple has already removed all configurations of the Apple Watch SE 3 from its official website.

Apple's official website shows that all Apple Watch SE 3 models are "currently out of stock".

It's widely expected that Apple will launch new iPhone and Apple Watch models at its event on September 9, and may also announce other products such as AirPods.

However, on the eve of the event, one of the existing Apple Watch models — the Apple Watch SE 3 — has already been discontinued on Apple's official website.

According to MacRumors, no matter how you configure any version of the Apple Watch SE 3, at the final step Apple's official website shows the model as "currently out of stock", whether you choose the delivery option or in-store pickup at an Apple Store.

Apple generally does not clear inventory before a product is ready to be replaced.

However, what's most puzzling this time is that there are absolutely no rumours about an Apple Watch SE 4 on the market.

Instead, we only expect two new models: the Apple Watch Series 12 and the Ultra 4.

The current out-of-stock situation may be a system glitch and will likely be restored soon. However, based on the current situation, it does seem to hint that a new generation of models may be unveiled tomorrow.

We will continue to update the latest availability status of the Apple Watch SE 3.
